Cold Application Winter Gloves

<!--Product Code:--> 0260103050111516

  • Description

White Cow Grain Leather on front &  back finger, Woven dotted fabric on back & cuff, Rubberized cuff, Full fur fabric liner, Edge binding with orange color fabric.

Available gloves sizing :

 

Product Detail:

Heavy Duty Winter Snow Leather Gloves. White Cow Grain Leather on front & back finger, Woven dotted fabric on back & cuff, Rubberized cuff, Full fur fabric liner, Edge binding with orange color fabric. Electronically warmed inserts for extreme cold.

Winter gloves are well-suited for camping, skiing, commuting, snow removal, logging, mountain climbing, and various other winter activities, catering to both men and women.

Our Leather Winter Gloves are meticulously designed and crafted by a global leader in leather safety goods. These gloves are the ultimate solution for those who demand both warmth and durability in cold environments. Whether you're working outdoors, handling materials in chilly conditions, or simply braving the winter weather, our gloves provide exceptional protection and comfort.

Key Features of Winter Leather Gloves:

White Cow Grain Leather on front & on back finger: The front and back fingers of the gloves are made from white cow grain leather. This high-quality leather is known for its strength, flexibility, and resistance to wear and tear, ensuring that your hands are well-protected and comfortable during use.

Woven Dotted Fabric: The back and cuff of the gloves are constructed with woven dotted fabric, adding an extra layer of durability and style. This fabric enhances grip and provides additional protection against abrasions and environmental elements.

Rubberized Cuff: The gloves feature a rubberized cuff, designed to provide a secure and snug fit. This cuff helps to keep out cold air and debris, ensuring that your hands remain warm and protected in harsh conditions.

Full Fur Fabric Liner: For ultimate insulation and comfort, the gloves are lined with full fur fabric. This soft and cozy lining traps heat effectively, keeping your hands warm even in the coldest environments.

Edge Binding with Orange Fabric: The gloves are finished with edge binding in a vibrant orange color. This not only adds a stylish touch but also enhances the durability of the gloves by preventing fraying and wear along the edges.

Enhanced Grip and Flexibility: The combination of cow grain leather and woven dotted fabric provides an excellent balance of grip and flexibility. This design ensures you can easily and precisely handle tools and materials, even in cold conditions.

Flexible Uses of Our Products:

Cold Weather Work: These gloves are designed for cold applications, making them perfect for outdoor work, construction, and maintenance in winter conditions. The superior insulation and durable materials ensure your hands remain warm and functional.

Material Handling: The robust construction and enhanced grip make these gloves ideal for material handling tasks in cold environments. Whether you're working in a warehouse, on a loading dock, or in a refrigerated setting, these gloves provide the protection you need.

General Winter Use: Beyond professional use, these gloves are also great for general winter activities such as shoveling snow, driving, or outdoor recreation. The stylish design and superior warmth make them a versatile addition to your winter wardrobe.

Product Specifications:

Material: White cow grain leather (front and back fingers), woven dotted fabric (back and cuff)

Cuff: Rubberized for secure fit

Lining: Full fur fabric for maximum warmth

Edge Binding: Orange color fabric for enhanced durability and style

Color: White with orange accents

Care Instructions:

To ensure the longevity and performance of Our Premium Leather Winter Gloves, follow these care instructions:

Cleaning: Wipe the leather with a damp cloth and mild soap. Avoid soaking the gloves or using harsh chemicals. The fabric parts can be spot cleaned as needed.

Drying: Allow the gloves to air dry naturally, away from direct heat sources and sunlight. Do not wring or tumble dry.

Storage: Store the gloves in a cool, dry place when not in use. Avoid crushing or folding to maintain their shape and integrity.

Our Premium Leather Winter Gloves combine the finest materials and expert craftsmanship to deliver unmatched warmth, protection, and durability in cold environments. Designed by a global leader in leather safety goods, these gloves are the perfect choice for professionals and outdoor enthusiasts alike. Experience the superior quality and performance of our Premium Leather Winter Gloves – your ultimate companion for winter work and play.
